Surya Namaskar, or Sun Salutation, is a sequence of 12 powerful yoga asanas best performed early morning on an empty stomach [PROG_Y_001]. Each complete round consists of two sets, starting with the right leg and then the left, with each posture coordinated with your breath [PROG_Y_001]. 

Regular practice provides a great cardiovascular workout, improves blood circulation, helps with weight loss (वजन घटाना), and reduces stress (*tanav*) [PROG_Y_001]. People with high blood pressure, hernia, or back problems should consult a doctor or certified instructor before performing it [PROG_Y_001].

Anulom Vilom ek powerful pranayama hai jo mind ko calm karta hai aur stress relieve karta hai [PROG_P_001]. 

Yeh body mein Tridoshas (Vata, Pitta, Kapha) ko balance karne mein madad karta hai aur patience aur concentration ko improve karta hai [PROG_P_001].

Healthy lifestyle ke liye ek balanced diet zaroori hai jisme carbohydrates, proteins, fats, vitamins, aur minerals ka mix ho [PROG_D_001]. 

Breakfast mein fried foods ki jagah poha, upma, ya idli lein [PROG_D_001]. Lunch mein 2 rotis, ek bowl dal, sabzi, aur salad khayein [PROG_D_001]. Dinner sabse halka hona chahiye, jiske liye khichdi ya dal ke sath vegetable stir-fry ek accha option hai [PROG_D_001]. 

Seasonal fruits aur vegetables shamil karein, aur din mein kam se kam 8-10 glasses paani piyein [PROG_D_001]. Processed sugar aur excessive salt se bachein [PROG_D_001]. Non-vegetarians ke liye fried preparations ki jagah grilled chicken ya fish zyada healthy hain, aur nuts & seeds se snacking karna cravings manage karne ka acha tarika hai [PROG_D_001].

Kapalbhati, or Skull Shining Breath, is an invigorating pranayama that cleanses the body through active, forceful exhalation and passive inhalation [PROG_P_002]. Sit comfortably with a straight spine, take a deep breath in, and exhale in short, powerful bursts while your stomach pumps inwards [PROG_P_002]. 

Start with a round of 20-30 pumps and do up to 3 rounds with breaks, preferably in the morning on an empty stomach [PROG_P_002]. It stimulates the digestive system, improves metabolic rate, and aids in weight loss [PROG_P_002]. Avoid this practice if you are pregnant, have high blood pressure, heart disease, hernia, or epilepsy [PROG_P_002].

Trikonasana, or Triangle Pose, is a foundational standing pose that stretches the entire body [PROG_Y_003]. To do it, stand with your feet wide apart, turn your right foot out 90 degrees, and extend your torso to the right while placing your right hand on your shin, ankle, or the floor [PROG_Y_003]. 

This pose stretches the hamstrings, hips, and spine, strengthens the legs and core, improves digestion, and is therapeutic for stress [PROG_Y_003]. You should avoid it if you have a headache, low blood pressure, or a neck injury, and remember not to lock your knees [PROG_Y_003].

Garmi ke liye aap Sheetali Pranayama (Cooling Breath) kar sakte hain. Isko karne ke liye comfortable hokar baithiye, apni tongue ko tube shape mein roll karke muh se bahar nikaaliye aur tube ke zariye dheere aur gehra inhale kijiye [PROG_P_004]. 

Fir tongue ko andar karke muh band kar lijiye aur nostrils ke zariye dheere se exhale kijiye. Isko 5-10 times repeat karein [PROG_P_004]. Ye body ko cool karta hai aur mental aur emotional excitation ko reduce karta hai [PROG_P_004]. 

Contraindications: Low blood pressure ya respiratory issues jaise asthma wale logon ke liye ye recommended nahi hai [PROG_P_004]. Isko clean environment mein practice karein [PROG_P_004].

Apni immunity badhane ke liye ek balanced diet lena zaroori hai [PROG_D_002]. Kuch behtareen foods hain:

- Citrus fruits jaise amla, oranges, aur lemons mein Vitamin C hota hai, jo immunity badhane mein madad karta hai [PROG_D_002].
- Turmeric (haldi) mein curcumin hota hai, jo ek anti-inflammatory compound hai; ise milk ya curries mein use karein [PROG_D_002].
- Ginger aur garlic bhi medicinal properties ke liye acche hain [PROG_D_002].
- Yogurt probiotics ka accha source hai jo gut health ke liye faydemand hai [PROG_D_002].
- Green leafy vegetables jaise spinach (palak) antioxidants se bhari hoti hain aur Almonds Vitamin E ka great source hain [PROG_D_002].

Yogi Devvrat is a certified RYT 500 Yoga Alliance instructor with over 15 years of experience who began his journey learning from traditional yoga gurus in Rishikesh [PROG_I_001]. His teaching style blends classical Hatha yoga with modern Vinyasa flow, focusing on alignment and breath [PROG_I_001]. He specializes in therapeutic yoga, helping clients manage chronic pain and stress-related ailments [PROG_I_001].

Millets are ancient grains that are gluten-free and rich in fiber, protein, and antioxidants [PROG_D_004]. They are considered a modern superfood for a healthy lifestyle rather than just gaon ka khana [PROG_D_004]. You can easily add them to your diet by making rotis from their flour or swapping rice with millet [PROG_D_004].

Aap relax karne ke liye Shavasana (Corpse Pose) practice kar sakte hain [PROG_Y_004]. Isme aapko flat on your back lie karna hota hai, eyes close karke aur tension (*thakaan*) release karni padti hai [PROG_Y_004]. Ye pose blood pressure reduce karne, nervous system calm karne aur insomnia combat karne mein help karta hai [PROG_Y_004]. Aapko isme at least 5-10 minutes spend karne chahiye [PROG_Y_004]. 

Aap Balasana (Childs Pose) bhi try kar sakte hain, jo ek gentle aur restorative yoga pose hai [PROG_Y_005]. Isme kneel on the floor karke, sit back on your heels aur fold forward karna hota hai [PROG_Y_005]. Ye brain calm karta hai aur stress aur fatigue alleviate karne mein help karta hai [PROG_Y_005].

Dia Malik is a certified clinical nutritionist with a Masters degree in Food and Nutrition [PROG_I_002]. She follows a no-deprivation approach and creates sustainable diet plans that fit your lifestyle and cultural eating habits [PROG_I_002]. You can book a one-on-one consultation with her to create a khaane ka plan (eating plan) that works for you [PROG_I_002]. She is available on Tuesdays and Thursdays from 4 PM to 6 PM [PROG_I_002].

Staying hydrated is crucial for overall health because water regulates body temperature, lubricates joints, and helps deliver nutrients to cells [PROG_D_003]. Dehydration can cause headaches, fatigue, and poor concentration [PROG_D_003]. Aim for 8-10 glasses of water per day, or more if you exercise or if it is a hot day [PROG_D_003]. Drinking water before meals can aid in weight management, is essential for kidney function, and helps flush out toxins [PROG_D_003]. You can infuse your water with lemon, cucumber, or mint leaves [PROG_D_003]. 

If you have any specific health concerns, I suggest speaking with a doctor.
